title: Car Klotski 3D
description: Slide parked sedans, trucks, and buses along a cramped lot to carve out a clear exit lane for your red hero car in the fewest moves possible.
controls: Drag vehicles forward or backward along their lanes until the target car can drive straight through the exit.

zh-CN.title: 汽车华容道
zh-CN.description: 经典烧脑华容道挪车神作：前后挪动挡路轿车与大巴腾出通道，用最少步数把红色主角车顺利开出拥堵停车场！
zh-CN.controls: 按住车辆沿车头或车尾方向滑动挪位，为主角车让出直通出口的通道即可过关。
